spans.s:
Arśas is the name of a disease mentioned in the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā with consumption and other ailments. It appears to designate ‘hæmorrhoids,’ as in the later medical literature.
Foot notes xii. 98.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 398; Roth, St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.

Arṣṭi-ṣeṇa.--Patronymic of Devāpi.
Foot notes Rv. x. 98, 5. 6. 8; nirukta, ii. 11; Bṛhaddevatā, vii. 155.
